eager.scope: Eager baseline, notification, live rows and handle/offset lifecycle.

options.scope: Public error/async retry forms, header/param preservation, parser/mapper/transformer order and initial/recovered status.

status_live_errors.scope: Disconnect during an already-live auth error and same-history resumption after asynchronous repair.

unsubscribe.scope: Individual stream/Shape callback removal while other subscribers continue receiving changes.

mobile.scope: Background/foreground and wake pause/resume through the real reader.

one_shot_status.scope: Completed subscribe:false readiness, disconnected status and retained public metadata.

replica.scope: Default/full projection and old changed values.

modes.scope: Cold changes-only/now boundaries and subsequent update classification.

unseen.scope: Changes-only unseen-key updates/deletes ignored until insertion through production transport.

subsets.scope: Subset API execution, injection, ordering, metadata and reconciliation.
subsets.remaining: Runtime subset gate remains open; retain these assertions for implementation after the source contract is available.

sse.scope: Native SSE event framing, reconnect, refresh, refetch and mode flags.

fixture_setup.scope: Original Electric service database fixture sanity check.
fixture_setup.remaining: Neon tests use independent isolated schemas and SQL comparisons; the original fixture remains an unrun reference.

types.remaining: Full incremental type/event and edge-case equivalence remains an open phase 7 gate.

delivery.scope: Serialized consumption, fan-out, offline replay and backpressure.

cache.scope: Electric HTTP cache/ETag/nginx assertions are historical; production serves the selected native JSON no-store policy.
cache.remaining: No claim of Electric cache-header, ETag/304 or nginx cache-collapse equivalence. Native conformance scope is explicitly selected.

filter.scope: Authorized WHERE passthrough, projection and membership changes.

quoted.scope: Explicit comma/quote-bearing projection excludes the space-bearing column; real baseline/live SQL comparison keeps one shape epoch in polling and SSE.

terminal_errors.scope: Real invalid SQL terminates the production client with safe native 400 JSON rather than Electric parser-location diagnostics.
terminal_errors.remaining: Electric-specific parser-location JSON is not reproduced; authorized SQL passes directly to Realtime.

resume_error.scope: A failed/truncated response cannot advance the committed checkpoint; recovery uses the observed handle and prior offset.

consumed_response.scope: Consumed/locked custom-fetch responses surface a terminal public FetchError without native network retries.
